name: 91 Diner
closed_reason: Closed for good on April 6, 2025 after 38 years; the property was sold to a gas station developer.

name: Green Olive Diner
closed_reason: Closed at the end of November 2025 after 16 years; the owners cited a large rent increase.

name: Bridgeport Flyer Diner
closed_reason: Closed February 23, 2025 when the owner retired; the family diner business dated to 1940 and the Milford (Devon) diner to 1973.

name: Jimmies of Savin Rock
closed_reason: Seaside restaurant opened in 1925 closed December 7, 2025 as the owners retired; the building stood empty behind fencing in March 2026.

name: Charcoal Chef
closed_reason: Roadside burger and comfort-food spot opened in 1956 served its last meal November 3, 2025 after 69 years.

name: Nardelli's Grinder Shoppe (Wallingford)
closed_reason: CT News Junkie (Dec 2025, citing CT Insider) reports the Wallingford store closed in April 2025 for health reasons; note the chain's own site still lists a North Colony Road, Wallingford store.
